summary.headline: Planetary Judgments by House
summary.text: Astrological judgments for planets in the midheaven and beginning of their meanings in the eleventh sign, including effects on journeys, dreams, wealth, captivity, authority, crafts, honors, and relations with kings and princes. Saturn’s differing indications in nocturnal and diurnal nativities are contrasted.
